message: Hi, my trail running shoes from order ORD-1042 arrived with the sole coming off. Can I get a refund please?

evidence.sql: SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-1042' AND customer_id = 'C003'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Shoes' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: The trail running shoes are defective and were delivered 15 days ago, within R3's 30-day window. Order total is $89.00, under the $200.00 auto-approve limit, and the item is not final sale. E1 confirms delivery on 2026-10-10, order total $89.00, category Shoes, final_sale false. E2 shows no approved refunds in the last 90 days, so R8 does not apply.

critique.reason: All factual claims are supported by evidence and agree with the Python checks: delivered 15 days ago within R3's 30-day defective window (E1, checks), $89.00 order total under the $200.00 auto-approve limit with over_auto_limit false (E1, checks), not final sale (E1, checks), order delivered and belongs to the customer (E1, checks), and 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days (checks; E2's only refund is for a different order, ORD-1005, dated 2025-12-02, outside the window), so R8 does not apply. No conflicts.

customer_reply: We're sorry to hear your Trail Running Shoes arrived with the sole coming off. We've approved a full refund for order ORD-1042, so please keep the shoes. A prepaid return label will be sent to you shortly.
limitations: Photo of the defect is not on file; approval relies on the customer's claim per policy within the 30-day window.
